searchText: Hey all, I'm currently working on EIP-8025 (optional proofs), but I'm keen to dive deeper into the stateless work being done here. For context, I previously implemented a binary trie in Scroll's reth fork (since deprecated as we migrated to native Ethereum MPT). Would appreciate pointers to current specs, research docs, and any client implementations to look at. Thanks! reference: https://github.com/scroll-tech/reth/tree/scroll/crates/scroll/trie EIP: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7864 EthMagician post with some extra clarifs/nuances: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7864-ethereum-state-using-a-unified-binary-tree/22611 Python spec: https://github.com/jsign/binary-tree-spec. i wrote this right after writing the eip, but i'd recommend pinging <@353136597522448385> (+stateless team) to know about latest updates. I think Guillaume is moving the spec to eels in this pr https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/2043/changes so prob better to take that as a ref.
